A gem in Ninh Binh: an authentic and unforgettable experience!
Jun 2026 • Friends
We found ourselves in Ninh Binh on an evening when my partner and I, along with another couple of friends, were unsure where to go for dinner. 
We were looking for true traditional Vietnamese dishes and, thanks to an internet search, we stumbled upon the "Trung Tuyet Restaurant," which boasted excellent reviews.
To be honest, at first we had a small moment of hesitation: we noticed that there hadn't been any recent reviews for quite some time, and that made us a bit doubtful. 
In the end, however, we decided to trust our instincts and try it anyway... and thank goodness we did!
During the evening we ordered:
 - The typical "Pho" (the traditional Vietnamese soup);
 - Noodles with beef and eggs;
 - Stir-fried vegetables;

Everything, from the soup to the noodles to the vegetables, was incredibly good, rich in flavor, and had a genuineness that was felt in every bite.

The atmosphere of the place captivated us right away with its extraordinary tranquility. Absolute credit goes to the girl who served us, who was always attentive to our needs throughout the evening. 
We also greatly appreciated the warm welcome they gave us, offering us typical Vietnamese sweets and mini bananas.
We absolutely do not understand why this place has been removed from official tourist guides like Lonely Planet, because it truly deserves so much.
In summary, for the four of us, it was definitely one of the best restaurants we have eaten at in all of Vietnam. 
We highly recommend it to everyone!
